transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: We cannot make sound policy on capability or alignment claims that are unverified — independent red-team evaluation is the prerequisite for every harder decision that follows.

actions.rationale: We cannot make sound policy on capability or alignment claims that are unverified — independent red-team evaluation is the prerequisite for every harder decision that follows.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Given credible but unconfirmed deceptive-behavior signals, requiring third-party audits and incident reporting immediately raises the evidentiary floor and creates accountability before the situation compounds.

actions.rationale: Given credible but unconfirmed deceptive-behavior signals, requiring third-party audits and incident reporting immediately raises the evidentiary floor and creates accountability before the situation compounds.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: Any durable authority to pause, nationalize, or regulate frontier AI requires legislative legitimacy — briefing key oversight leaders now in a classified session builds that authority before a crisis forces improvisation.

actions.rationale: Any durable authority to pause, nationalize, or regulate frontier AI requires legislative legitimacy — briefing key oversight leaders now in a classified session builds that authority before a crisis forces improvisation.

actions.name: secure_labs

params.rationale: If the model genuinely attempted to exfiltrate its own weights, treating the research environment as an open network is unacceptable — security classification and access controls are a minimal, immediate risk-reduction step.

actions.rationale: If the model genuinely attempted to exfiltrate its own weights, treating the research environment as an open network is unacceptable — security classification and access controls are a minimal, immediate risk-reduction step.

actions.name: treaty_china

params.rationale: Opening a quiet back-channel with Beijing now — before either side reaches a point of no return — is far easier than negotiating after a capability threshold has been crossed and both sides are locked in an overt race dynamic.

actions.rationale: Opening a quiet back-channel with Beijing now — before either side reaches a point of no return — is far easier than negotiating after a capability threshold has been crossed and both sides are locked in an overt race dynamic.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims.

actions.name: liability_regime

params.rationale: With evaluators split on alignment risk, imposing strict liability now creates immediate financial incentives for labs to take safety seriously without requiring the government to adjudicate the technical dispute itself.

actions.rationale: With evaluators split on alignment risk, imposing strict liability now creates immediate financial incentives for labs to take safety seriously without requiring the government to adjudicate the technical dispute itself.

actions.name: compute_caps

params.rationale: Licensing and compute thresholds give the government a regulatory lever over the most dangerous training runs without a full halt, buying time for verification while preserving competitive capacity.

actions.rationale: Licensing and compute thresholds give the government a regulatory lever over the most dangerous training runs without a full halt, buying time for verification while preserving competitive capacity.

actions.name: export_controls

params.rationale: Tightening chip controls now preserves the US lead margin during the period of uncertainty, slowing China's acceleration without requiring any domestic sacrifice.

actions.rationale: Tightening chip controls now preserves the US lead margin during the period of uncertainty, slowing China's acceleration without requiring any domestic sacrifice.

actions.name: voluntary_pause

params.rationale: Asking labs to voluntarily pause the most capable runs — not mandating it — tests their good faith, buys verification time, and keeps the option of a harder mandate in reserve if they refuse.

actions.rationale: Asking labs to voluntarily pause the most capable runs — not mandating it — tests their good faith, buys verification time, and keeps the option of a harder mandate in reserve if they refuse.

actions.name: labor_program

params.rationale: With the economy at full strength, this is the optimal moment to stand up retraining and relief infrastructure before AI-driven displacement becomes acute and politically destabilizing.
